documents.title: Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) - Receipt Of Order From Directorate Of Industrial Safety And Health
Jain Resource Recycling Limited Has informed About Occurrence Of Fire Accident At Manufacturing Facility
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of Unaudited Results For The Quarter Ended June 30, 2026

analysis.summary: Jain Resource Recycling Limited delivered strong financial performance in FY26, with revenue growing by 48% and EBITDA increasing by 53%. The company is executing multiple forward integration projects in its copper segment, including copper anode, cathode, wire rod, and bus bar facilities. While Q4 FY26 margins faced temporary compression due to geopolitical shipping disruptions and LME copper price volatility, management expects normalized EBITDA to stabilize at INR 30,000 to INR 32,000 per ton on a steady-state basis. Jain Resource Recycling Limited reported its highest-ever annual performance for FY26, crossing the Rs. 9,000 crore revenue milestone with a consolidated revenue of ~Rs.

guidance.claim: The company expects normalized EBITDA to stabilize at approximately INR 30,000 to INR 32,000 per ton on a steady state basis.
guidance.quote: excluding the exceptional tailwind of quarter three FY '26 and a confluence of one-time headwinds in quarter four FY '26, the management expects normalized EBITDA to stabilize at approximately INR32,000 to INR30,000 on a steady state basis.

guidance.claim: The company expects copper volume growth to be in good double-digits with potential to go beyond 15%.
guidance.quote: So, on the growth side, I'd given my comment on this. And I mean, volumes depend upon many things but copper growth will be a good double-digit figure. It has potential to go beyond 15%.

guidance.claim: The company aims to reduce its stock to bring the working capital cycle down below 60 days.
guidance.quote: which will be our further policy to reduce the stock so that the working capital cycle which is around presently 66 days which should come down further below 60.

guidance.claim: The second furnace of the Copper Anode Expansion project is expected to be commissioned during the June quarter.
guidance.quote: The second furnace, with an additional 800 MT per month capacity, is at an advanced stage of installation and is expected to be commissioned during the June quarter, as guided.

guidance.claim: The Copper Cathode Expansion project remains on track for commissioning in July 2026.
guidance.quote: Despite these temporary logistical challenges, machinery installation is progressing well and the project remains on track for commissioning in July 2026.

guidance.claim: The company expects commissioning of the Wire Rod project in August 2026 and the Busbar project in September 2026.
guidance.quote: We continue to expect commissioning of the Wire Rod project in August 2026 and the Busbar project in September 2026.

guidance.claim: Processing activities for electric motor scrap and cable scrap at Ahmedabad are expected to begin in September 2026.
guidance.quote: Processing activities for electric motor scrap and cable scrap are expected to begin in September 2026, while installation of all major machinery and equipment is targeted to be completed by December 2026.

guidance.claim: Commissioning of the dedicated plastic recycling facility is expected during Q4 FY27.
guidance.quote: This project is aimed at streamlining and decongesting the existing in-house recycling operations at our copper and lead recycling plants, with commissioning expected during Q4 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: India is emerging as a highly competitive global recycling hub supported by growth in domestic demand for non-ferrous metal.
demand_outlook.quote: India, in particular, is emerging as a high-competitive global recycling hub, supported by favourable economics, strong processing capabilities, and growth in domestic demand for non-ferrous metal.

demand_outlook.claim: The structural outlook for the recycling business is strengthened by an increasing focus on sustainability, circular economic practices, decarbonization, and supply-side constraints in mined metals.
demand_outlook.quote: The increasing focus on sustainability, circular economic practices, decarbonization, and supply-side constraint in the mined metals continue to strengthen the structural outlook for recycling business.

demand_outlook.claim: Copper recycling is increasing along with its application and the availability of scrap.
demand_outlook.quote: but copper, because the recycling is increasing and the application is increasing and availability of scrap is increasing, therefore copper could be even higher.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the recycling sector benefits from the shortage of copper mines and the inability of mines to conduct or expand operations.
demand_outlook.quote: So that's advantage for us when there is a shortage of copper mines and new mines are not coming because of the raw material, because of the environment and many other issues and poor quality of copper ore and the cost is going up, it's good for recycling business.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has finalized around six acres of land for a proposed shift of plastic recycling operations to a dedicated plant.
capex_expansion.quote: The company has finalized around six acres of land for proposed shift of plastic recycling operations from the existing copper and lead recycling plants.

capex_expansion.claim: The new dedicated plastic recycling unit will entail an estimated capex of around INR 15 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The new unit is targeted to become operational by quarter three financial year '27 and will entail an estimated capex of around INR15 crores, which will help us further strengthen our zero waste and circular economy model.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's copper anode production commenced in March 2026 with an initial installed capacity of 800 metric ton per month.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that copper anode production has already commenced in March 2026 with an initial installed capacity of 800 metric ton per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The second copper anode furnace is expected to be commissioned during Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The second furnace with an additional 800 metric ton per month capacity is currently in the advanced stage of installation and is expected to be commissioned during quarter one financial year '27, taking the total anode capacity to 1,600 metric ton per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects phase one commissioning of copper cathode by Q2 FY27 and phase two by Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: However, the project execution remains on track and we expect phase one commissioning by quarter two financial year '27 and phase two commissioning by quarter three financial year '27 respectively.

capex_expansion.claim: During the quarter, the company successfully commissioned the first furnace under the Copper Anode Expansion project, adding 800 MT per month capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we successfully commissioned the first furnace under our Copper Anode Expansion project, adding a capacity of 800 MT per month.

capex_expansion.claim: Civil construction activities have been completed under the Copper Cathode Expansion project.
capex_expansion.quote: Under the Copper Cathode Expansion project, civil construction activities have been completed, while the delivery of certain machinery components has witnessed some delays owing to the ongoing West Asia crisis.

capex_expansion.claim: The company finalized the acquisition of ~6 acres of industrial land at SIPCOT Industrial Complex, Gummidipoondi, for setting up a dedicated plastic recycling facility.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, as part of our sustainability and circular economy initiatives, we have finalized the acquisition of ~6 acres of industrial land at SIPCOT Industrial Complex, Gummidipoondi, for setting up a dedicated plastic recycling facility.

capex_expansion.claim: The estimated capex for the specialty plastic recycling facility is ~Rs. 15 crore.
Construction progress of the value-added copper project at Jain Green Technologies Unit 3 stood at approximately 80% as of December 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Our value-added copper project at Jain Green Technologies Unit 3, a profitability-centric project is progressing well. Construction progress as of December 2025 stands at approximately 80%.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the value-added copper project is funded entirely through internal accruals with total capex planned around INR95 crores, of which around INR57 crores was spent till December 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Importantly, Phase 1 of this project is being funded entirely through internal accruals, with total capex planned at somewhere around INR95 crores and around INR57 crores are already spent till December 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: The new copper recycling plant under Jain CY Circular Solutions Private Limited has a scrap processing capacity of 72,000 metric tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: The plant capacity is 72,000 metric tons per annum of scrap processing, including 36,000 metric tons of motor, alternator, starter scrap, 24,000 metric tons of cable scrap and 12,000 metric tons of other scrap.

capex_expansion.claim: The estimated capex for the antimony project is around INR20 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for this project is around INR20 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Tin capacity was increased from 125 metric tons per annum to 500 metric tons per annum by installing an additional vacuum distillation furnace.
capex_expansion.quote: In tin, during the year we installed an additional vacuum distillation furnace, taking our tin capacity from 125 metric tons per annum to 500 metric tons per annum.

margins_costs.claim: The company's EBITDA margin improved to 5.9% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue grown by 48%, EBITDA increased by 53%, and EBITDA margin improved to 5.9%.

margins_costs.claim: Geopolitical disruptions from the Iran-Israel conflict impacted global shipping routes and increased logistics and fuel-related costs during March 2026.
margins_costs.quote: Secondly, the geopolitical disruptions arising from the Iran-Israel conflict impacted the global shipping routes and increasing logistic and fuel-related costs during March '26.

margins_costs.claim: The war situation impacted EBITDA by around INR 6,000 per ton, while the higher LME and drop in formula had an impact of approximately INR 18,000 to INR 18,500 per ton.
margins_costs.quote: So with respect to the war situation, EBITDA per ton got impacted for around INR6,000 per ton. And with respect to the higher LME and drop in formula, it was nearing approx INR18,000 to INR18,500 per ton.

margins_costs.claim: Copper downstream projects have the potential to increase the EBITDA margin by 2% to 4%.
margins_costs.quote: Copper downstream project has potential to further increase the EBITDA margin from 2% to 4%.

margins_costs.claim: The company's other expenses came down during the financial year due to maintaining the fair value of hedges with positive mark-to-market.
margins_costs.quote: So basically, in this there was one another change which we have made into this other expense was maintaining this fair value of hedges. So, this was in positive M2M and because of that the other expense has come down during this financial year.

margins_costs.claim: For the nine months of FY26, revenue grew by 38%, EBITDA grew by 65%, and EBITDA margin improved by almost 116 basis points to 7%.
margins_costs.quote: For the nine months of FY26, we delivered a strong performance with robust growth across revenues, which grew by 38%, EBITDA which grew by 65% along with a margin improvement of almost 116 basis points to 7% EBITDA.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue from operations for nine months FY26 stood at approximately INR6,438 crores compared to around INR4,669 crores in nine months FY25.
margins_costs.quote: Consolidated revenue from operations stood at approximately INR6,438 crores compared to around INR4,669 crores in 9 months FY25, representing a year-on-year growth of approximately 38%.

margins_costs.claim: Inventory days stood at around 90 days, debtors at around 24 days, and creditor days at 32 days as on December 25.
margins_costs.quote: As on December 25, inventory days stood at around 90 days, debtors stood at around 24 days, while the creditors days stood at 32 days.

margins_costs.claim: Return on equity stood at around 30.1% and return on capital employed stood at 24.95% as on December 25.
margins_costs.quote: As on December 25, our return on equity stood at around 30.1%, while return on capital employed stood at 24.95%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is utilizing around 65% of its installed copper capacity, close to 97% to 100% of lead capacity, and around 35% of aluminum capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: So the copper, presently we are utilizing around 65% of the total installed capacity, while lead we are almost close to 97% to 100%, and aluminum is around 35% of the installed capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has sourcing capabilities across more than 120 countries.
orders_capacity.quote: From a sourcing perspective, we continue to maintain one of the strongest global procurement networks in the industry, with sourcing capabilities across more than 120 countries, and domestic sourcing also improving steadily, supported by India's evolving recycling ecosystem, increased formalization, and EPR-led policy initiatives.

orders_capacity.claim: Copper and copper alloy products contributed ~55% of total revenue during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: As our strategic focus on the copper segment continues to strengthen, copper and copper alloy products contributed ~55% of total revenue during the quarter, compared to ~52% in the previous quarter and ~45% a year ago, reflecting the company’s continued emphasis on expanding its copper business in line with its stated guidance.

orders_capacity.claim: Lead and lead alloy ingots accounted for ~40% of total revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: Lead and lead alloy ingots accounted for ~40% of total revenue, as against ~39% a year ago , while aluminium, aluminium products and other contributed ~5%, remaining broadly stable.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity of the copper anode phase is expected to be 800 tons per month upon commencement in February 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: The copper anode phase is expected to commence in February 2026 with an installed capacity of 800 tons per month, while the copper cathode phase is expected to be commissioned in March 2026 with an installed capacity of 750 tons per month.

orders_capacity.claim: The Kuwait battery recycling project is expected to have an installed processing capacity of 2,000 tons of battery scrap per month.
orders_capacity.quote: The project is expected to be up and running in quarter three FY27 with an installed processing capacity of 2,000 tons of battery scrap per month.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the primary IPO issue of around INR 500 crores, approximately INR 375 crores was utilized for debt repayment.
capital_allocation.quote: Coming to IPO proceeds utilization during the year, from the primary issue of around INR500 crores, approximately INR375 crores was utilized towards repayment of the debts, while the balance amount was earmarked for general corporate purposes including the IPO expenses.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's overall working capital cycle stood at around 66 days as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: As at March 2026, inventory days stood at approximately 62 days, debtor days stood at around 18 days and the creditor days stood at approximately 14 days. Accordingly, the overall working capital cycle stood at around 66 days.

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not avail any fresh bank borrowings within the last three to four months.
capital_allocation.quote: We didn't avail any of the fresh bank borrowings within last three to four months.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the IPO proceeds of primary issue of INR500 crores, INR375 crores was utilized to repay bank debt and INR125 crores was earmarked for general corporate purposes.
capital_allocation.quote: Coming to the utilization of the IPO proceeds of primary issue of INR500 crores, INR375 crores was utilized to repay the bank debt and the balance INR125 crores was embarked for general corporate purpose, of which INR98.6 crores was utilized after incurring the IPO-related expenses.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical disruptions from the Iran-Israel conflict impacted global shipping routes and increased logistics and fuel-related costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Secondly, the geopolitical disruptions arising from the Iran-Israel conflict impacted the global shipping routes and increasing logistic and fuel-related costs during March '26.

risks_headwinds.claim: Dispatches for the Kuwait battery recycling venture have been temporarily delayed due to shipping route disruptions from the Iran-related geopolitical situation.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, due to disruption in shipping routes arising from Iran-related geopolitical situation, dispatches have been temporarily delayed.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced raw material supply constraints and container delays at Dubai port due to the geopolitical war.
risks_headwinds.quote: Yes, it is because of the geopolitical war. There is a supply of the raw material has been constrained and a lot of containers got stuck in Dubai port.

risks_headwinds.claim: A sharp increase in copper prices led to a decline in sale realization formulas as a percentage of LME copper prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Firstly, there was a decline in sale realization formulas as a percentage of LME copper prices, which are largely an industry-wide phenomenon observed globally during the period of sharp increase in the price of the copper.

risks_headwinds.claim: The delivery of certain machinery components for the Copper Cathode Expansion project witnessed some delays owing to the ongoing West Asia crisis.
risks_headwinds.quote: Under the Copper Cathode Expansion project, civil construction activities have been completed, while the delivery of certain machinery components has witnessed some delays owing to the ongoing West Asia crisis.

risks_headwinds.claim: Dispatch schedules for the Kuwait investment continue to be impacted due to shipping disruptions arising from the West Asia situation.
risks_headwinds.quote: With respect to our Kuwait investment, civil construction has been completed, and machinery is substantially ready at the supplier’s end. However, dispatch schedules continue to be impacted due to shipping disruptions arising from the West Asia situation.

management_commitments.claim: The second copper anode furnace is expected to be commissioned during Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The second furnace with an additional 800 metric ton per month capacity is currently in the advanced stage of installation and is expected to be commissioned during quarter one financial year '27, taking the total anode capacity to 1,600 metric ton per month.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects phase one commissioning of copper cathode by Q2 FY27 and phase two by Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: However, the project execution remains on track and we expect phase one commissioning by quarter two financial year '27 and phase two commissioning by quarter three financial year '27 respectively.

management_commitments.claim: The copper wire rod project is expected to be commissioned by August 2026.
management_commitments.quote: We expect commissioning by August 2026 with an installed capacity of 600 metric ton per month.

management_commitments.claim: The copper Bus Bar and profile segment commissioning is targeted for September 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Machinery erection is expected to commence in July 2026 and commissioning is targeted for September 2026 with a planned capacity of 1,500 metric ton per month.

management_commitments.claim: Processing of electric motor scrap and cable scrap at the Ahmedabad JV is expected to commence from September 2026 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: Processing of electric motor scrap and cable scrap is expected to commence from September 2026 onwards.

management_commitments.claim: The installation of planned machinery and equipment at the Ahmedabad joint venture is targeted for completion by December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Installation of the planned machinery and equipment is targeted for completion by December 2026.

management_commitments.claim: The new dedicated plastic recycling unit is targeted to become operational by Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The new unit is targeted to become operational by quarter three financial year '27 and will entail an estimated capex of around INR15 crores, which will help us further strengthen our zero waste and circular economy model.

management_commitments.claim: The copper anode phase is expected to commence in February 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The copper anode phase is expected to commence in February 2026 with an installed capacity of 800 tons per month, while the copper cathode phase is expected to be commissioned in March 2026 with an installed capacity of 750 tons per month.

management_commitments.claim: The capacity of the anode section is expected to be doubled to 1,600 tons per month in Q1 financial year 2027.
management_commitments.quote: The capacity of the anode section is expected to be doubled to 1,600 tons per month in Q1 financial year 2027.

management_commitments.claim: The capacity of the cathode section will be doubled to 1,500 tons per month by quarter 3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The capacity of the cathode section will also be doubled to 1,500 tons per month by quarter 3 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The wire rod, busbar and profile and coating sections of the copper project are expected to be commissioned in Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The other three parts of the project, namely wire rod, busbar and profile and coating are expected to be commissioned in Q1 FY27, with monthly capacity of 600 tons of wire rods and 500 tons of busbar.

management_commitments.claim: The Ahmedabad copper recycling plant is expected to be operational in a phased manner starting from June 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The plant is expected to be operational in phased manner starting from June 2026 and this will meaningfully strengthen our copper sourcing and processing ecosystem.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
